runtime.note: RLDX setup installs moving robosuite master. This project pins the tested revision; installs editable sources without their obsolete/conflicting dependency resolution.

assets.note: Legacy upstream Box links return404. Mirror mug subset is range-fetched and individually CRC/SHA256 checked. Only coffee tasks supported; no complete Objaverse installation. Asset licenses must be assessed independently of mirror metadata.

parity.render: 512 RGB vertical flip then cv2 INTER_AREA256
parity.caveat: Exact RLDX training asset archive hashes are not published, so full historical asset parity is unverified. Data shape and native task/controller compatibility are separately verified.
